title: Consuming APIs with React Query: cache, invalidation and loading states

videos.script:
Until now, a reload lost every change. Today the planner gets a server to talk to, and a library to do the talking.

{{server}} First the server: a small API in plain Node, three routes, every line in the lesson. It checks everything it receives, because what reaches a server is not always your form.

{{why}} Then the question of why lesson five's fetch is not enough. Data from a server is not yours. It is a copy, and a copy goes stale.

{{query}} TanStack Query, still called React Query, keeps that copy under a key. You will see strict mode run the query twice, and one request leave the page.

{{mutate}} Then changes. Tick a session, and you will watch a PATCH go out, the cache be told it is stale, and the data come back fresh. Reload, and the change is still there.

{{retry}} And last, a server that does not answer. Four tries, a growing wait between them, and only then the error on the screen.
